signals_info.description: Normalized risk for the selected pedestrian or cyclist; values above 0.7 form the selected high-risk predicate.

time_info.description: Bounded risk-state satisfaction window including the current time.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some time from now through the next 3 seconds, the vulnerable-road-user risk shall be less than or equal to 0.7.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从当前起至接下来的 3 秒内，弱势道路使用者风险应至少有一个时刻小于或等于 0.7。
nl_Paraphrase_en: Within the 3-second window including now, the assessed pedestrian-or-cyclist risk shall be no greater than 0.7 at least once.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在包含当前时刻的 3 秒窗口内，行人或骑行者风险评估值应至少有一个时刻不高于 0.7。
